children: LANDS' END, INC. reported second-quarter 2026 results with revenue of $302M, up from $294.1M a year earlier, and net income of $3.5M versus a net loss in the prior-year quarter; diluted EPS was $0.11 compared with $(0.12) in Q2 2025.
Revenue was $302.0M for Q2 2026, compared with $294.1M in the year‑ago quarter; YoY change 2.7%.
Net income was $3.5M for Q2 2026, compared with a net loss of $(3.7)M in the year‑ago quarter.
Diluted EPS was $0.11 for Q2 2026, compared with $(0.12) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue growth in Q2 was driven by strength in U.S. Digital (U.S. eCommerce, Outfitters and Third Party), though year‑to‑date revenue is down 2.6% versus the prior year.
Company shifted channel mix, with Third Party volume de‑emphasized to favor higher‑value digital sales.
Closed the WHP joint venture on April 1, 2026; the 50% sale establishes a licensing/royalty structure with guaranteed minimums.
Implemented a new warehouse management system during the quarter, which caused temporary disruptions and carryover shipments.
Gross margin expanded to 52.0% in Q2, aided by a tariff refund, while marketing and operational inefficiencies increased selling, general and administrative expenses.
